summary: Class Purse is a transparent class fund for university students on Celo: a class rep opens a purse with a name, a G$ target and a deadline, members pay in G$, and everyone sees who paid and how much. This first milestone is a fully clickable local preview with clearly labelled sample data: no contracts, no wallet, no real G$ moves.
direction: Midnight student ledger: deep navy surfaces with one gold accent, Space Grotesk headings with tight tracking and DM Sans body, small uppercase spaced labels, big tabular numbers, a thick gold progress bar as the page's hero, soft borders and generous vertical space, a tilted demo purse card on the home hero, and one stacked column on a phone.
